name: Full-scan aggregation
why: Count every record in the window grouped by level. No index helps; this is raw scan throughput over the whole corpus.

pulsetrace.unsupported: PulseTrace has no aggregation API for logs. The log surface exposes filters and a row limit, not GROUP BY — a user cannot ask this question at all. This is dimension D3 (query power) measured rather than asserted, and it is what phase P3 exists to fix.

query.sql: SELECT level, count(*) AS n FROM bench_logs GROUP BY level ORDER BY n DESC
